notes.title: The Doulos Study 1.5 Update
notes.notes:
Update 1.5 Patch Notes


 Improved animations
 Players can now save more than 2 player save slots
 Correct answers now display when you get the answer wrong
 After quiz is finished, you are now shown bible references to study for improvement
 You can now change resolutions
 Added sound effects
 Players can now change background colors
 Gamepad controls are now fully supported

notes.title: Update 1.22 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The Doulos Study 1.22 Patch Notes


 Players can now customize the color of cursor effects
 Added new visual setting option
 Added "Dark Mode" to visual options
 Corrected spelling on some questions
 Improved pause menu
 Rescaled some images and ui in the options menus

notes.title: Update 1.21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The Doulos Study 1.21 Patch Notes


 Improved options menus
 Added new cursor effects options
 Added new answer result animations
 Rescaled some scene images
 Added graphics to menus and high score display
 Fixed issue with floor images
 Improved text on high score display
 Updated pause menu

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.12
notes.notes:
The Doulos Study Patch Notes 1.12


 Fixed text rendering for Options menu
 
 Fixed text rendering for answer text in each game mode
 
 Fixed frame rate issues regarding the timer in Time Challenge mode
 
 Added platform availability for Mac and Linux 
 
 Update went live July 19th 2019


Please contact Jesse Leyk with any issues.

notes.title: Today Is Release Day
notes.notes: The Doulos Study releases today at 0600 PDT. Please contact Jesse Leyk if you have problems or suggested improvements to The Doulos Study.
